title: emma-liu-dx-sdk-scratchpad
content:
Quick scratchpad for SDK docs / sample apps / tutorial fixes - living todo list.

2026-02-20
- Sync notes after weekly DX meeting with Mikaela & Devon.
- Priority: fix quickstart tutorial (JS + Python) that new users hit. Several reports of broken streaming example.

Open problems / root causes seen so far:
- Quickstart streaming example uses old client API (messages vs. chat). Need unified examples for text, chat, and streaming.
- Example uses .stream() which errors on older hosted accounts due to missing headers (auth flow mismatch).
- Python sample app (notebook) has blocking sync calls that cause UI freeze in tutorial video.

Immediate todos (short-term) — pick up this sprint:
- [ ] Update README quickstart (JS) to use new client.chat.create + streaming chunk example (assign: Emma).
- [ ] Add note about required headers for streaming and fallback non-streaming code path (assign: Devon).
- [ ] Patch Python notebook to use async/await pattern and add cell that explains event loop caveat (assign: Mikaela).
- [ ] File a small fix PR to include minimal deploy script for sample-app (GH PR #412 referenced).

Sample app ideas to add to examples/ directory (mid-term):
- local-compose-demo: small repo that runs Redwood Private compatibility locally with mocked routing (teaches routing/fallback).
- embeddings-search-demo: Next.js + simple vector DB example using SDK embeddings + reranking pipeline (good benchmark for customers asking about cost).
- websocket-chatbot: demonstrate streaming + function calling + tool-handoff (edge-case doc coverage).

Docs gaps noticed (longer list):
- Function/tool calling examples: most examples show one tool. Need multi-tool orchestration and error-handling patterns.
- Quantization/compatibility note: guide for when a model variant is fallbacked (how SDK surface looks, what to log).
- Rate-limit behavior: show sample exponential backoff snippet; link to console rate limit dashboard.
- Rollouts & pinning: simple tutorial on pinning model versions per route (config + SDK snippet).

User reports / quotes to address in doc changes:
- "Streaming example just stops midway, no errors in console" — likely missing chunked transfer headers; add troubleshooting section.
- "How do I test offline (private) without prod credentials?" — add mock modes or local dev instruction.

Small code snippets to include in quickstart (put into examples/quickstart):
- JS streaming minimal: (inline pseudo)
  const resp = await client.chat.create({ model: 'redwood/gpt-4o-lite', input: 'hello', stream: true });
  for await (const chunk of resp.stream()) { renderChunk(chunk); }
  // fallback: if stream unsupported -> const out = await client.chat.create(..., stream: false)

- Python async:
  import asyncio
  from redwood_sdk import Client
  async def main():
    client = Client(api_key=...)
    async for chunk in client.chat.stream(model='redwood/gpt-4o-lite', input='hi'):
      print(chunk)
  asyncio.run(main())

UX / tutorial fixes:
- Video voiceover mentions "install redwood-sdk@latest" but our package name is @redwood/inference-sdk — update script and transcript.
- Add tiny GIFs showing streaming vs non-streaming behavior in quickstart. GIFs can be hosted in assets/ and linked.

Testing checklist before merge:
- [ ] Run quickstart JS on fresh account (no special flags) — ensure auth + stream fallback works.
- [ ] Run Python notebook in Colab & local venv.
- [ ] Lint docs (mdx) and run static site build locally.
- [ ] Cross-link to Console docs: rate-limits, model catalog, rollouts.

Outstanding questions (need input):
- Do we want to support both 'messages' and 'input' in examples for backwards compatibility? (ask platform-eng/runtime team)
- Should sample-apps include infra as code for Dedicated (probably overkill) — prefer simple dev-facing examples.

Notes from last sync with platform-engineering (2026-02-18):
- They will add headers in router to indicate streaming-capability (X-RW-Stream-Capable) — docs should detect and show how to check response headers.
- Runtime will return model-fallback metadata on 4xx->200 path; add snippet to read response.meta.fallback_reason.

Action plan for next week:
- Emma: implement JS quickstart patch + update transcript (ETA: 2026-02-25).
- Devon: write fallback troubleshooting section + backoff snippet (ETA: 2026-02-24).
- Mikaela: update Python notebook with async pattern + Colab link (ETA: 2026-02-26).
- Jordan: prep small sample-app scaffolding for embeddings-search-demo (ETA: 2026-03-05).

Random notes / TODOs to offload later:
- Move larger tutorial content into 'tutorials/streaming-and-tools.md' and link from quickstart.
- Collect customer-reported logs for three streaming incidents and attach sanitized logs to JIRA DX-137.
- Consider adding a troubleshooting CLI: 'rwctl check-streaming' that checks headers and prints recommended config.

— — END SCRATCHPAD — —
(Keep this doc as the working todo; create PR notes from items above when ready.)
